source_revisions.worktree_scope: Both source checkouts were non-pristine Lyrical/Jetty migration workspaces. The DVL launch/model/bridge files and ros_gz DVL conversion source quoted in source_audit.txt were not listed as modified; ros_gz CMake files and other DAVE migration files were modified.

tested_paths: official stock DVL world forced from ogre2 to ogre
mac.scope: The controls rule out a DAVE-only world defect, a GUI-client-only defect, and an ogre2-only defect. They do not identify the exact lower-level macOS root cause.

bottom_range_control.scope: One flat target and one geometry; this is not a general acoustic-accuracy validation.

moving_platform_control.frame_mapping_note: The model's ENU-to-FSD reference transform maps positive world X motion approximately to negative DVL Y.

dave_custom_bridge.finding: DVLBridge copies the timestamp but not the Gazebo frame_id, so every directly sampled ROS message had an empty frame_id.

dave_configuration_control.finding: Without bottom return, the shipped DAVE configuration did not produce a water-mass estimate. The world has no environmental-data loader, and the water_velocity x/y/z elements contain 0., which the Gazebo API treats as environmental variable names rather than numeric vector components.

corrected_environment_control.scope: This proves the Gazebo water-mass path works when time-varying environmental data and matching variable names are supplied; it does not validate a real ocean profile.

documentation_corrections: The launch argument is verbosity_level with default 1, not verbose with default 0.
The current Lyrical ros_gz bridge supports gz.msgs.DVLVelocityTracking to marine_acoustic_msgs/msg/Dvl.
The available-sensors link on the page is broken.
The current Mac and Docker verdicts must be separated.
